dashboard.label: TA-kernel Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype kernel:metrics); series prefixed 'kernel.'.

search.query: | mstats avg("kernel.uptime_s") as value where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename value as "kernel.uptime_s"
| mstats avg("kernel.tainted") as value where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename value as "kernel.tainted"

panel.title: New kernel bad events (oops / panic / bug) per cycle

search.query: | mstats avg("kernel.*_new") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "kernel.*_new"
| mstats avg("kernel.kdump_active") as value where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename value as "kernel.kdump_active"
| mstats avg("kernel.kexec_crash_loaded") as value where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename value as "kernel.kexec_crash_loaded"
| mstats avg("kernel.journal_readable") as value where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename value as "kernel.journal_readable"
